description: Compare two people's numerology Life Path numbers from their birth dates: both numbers with each step of the sum and their approved meanings, then how the two styles meet, how the numbers relate (same number, the groups 1-5-7, 2-4-8 and 3-6-9, master numbers read with their root) and one gentle balance line, with a link to the free Life Path page. Use when someone asks "are our life path numbers compatible", "life path compatibility", "numerology compatibility" or "my life path 7 and their 3". The sums keep the master numbers 11, 22 and 33, which adding all digits at once loses. Only the two birth dates are needed. Takes birth details only, never names or contact details, and stores nothing. It describes tendencies for reflection, never a verdict on whether a relationship will work or last.

them.description: Birth details of the other person, only what the user chose to share. No name or contact details.

you.description: Birth details of the person asking. No name or contact details.
